run_function_add_var: run the add_var numba kernel to incrementally update variance statistics with a new value
run_function_remove_var: run the remove_var numba kernel to decrementally update variance statistics by removing a value
run_function_sliding_var: run the sliding_var numba kernel to compute variance over sliding windows defined by start and end index arrays
run_function_grouped_var: run the grouped_var numba kernel to compute variance grouped by integer labels with min_periods and ddof support
summarize_module_var_kernels: summarize the numba-accelerated 1D variance kernels shared by DataFrame, Series, groupby, and rolling operations
